items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the inner part of the Hochma in the secret of Daat? It is known that the principal bearer of this Hochma of the thirty-two paths is the Tifferet, namely ZA, which includes the five Hassadim. For Bina never returns to be Hochma except by the power of the Tifferet, which, with the joining of the crown of Gevura, is called Daat. Therefore the inner part of this Hochma is discerned as being seen from within the Daat, namely from within the Tifferet, which bears it also in the aspect of the Hochma of Bina herself, for both from the aspect of its drawing and revelation, and from the aspect of the standing and existence of the Mochin of Hochma with her, it is not supported except on the Tifferet, which is the Daat. (Item 87).
